methodology.execution: Production Vite SSR bundle; fresh Node process per scenario; no dev server, test runner, Worker transport or UI
methodology.coldDefinition: First simulation after modules, repository and service are loaded; includes first-use compilation/JIT, excludes module loading/build
methodology.cachePolicy: reuseCheckpoint=false; clearCache before each run; inherited scenarios rejected; immutable definition compilation caches retain production lifetime
methodology.simulationMs: Official service stage: compilation, runtime setup, combat advance, core result/resource collection
methodology.projectionMs: Official service stage: enemy health, poise and diagnostics projection/publication
methodology.cloneMs: Separate structuredClone of official Worker-transferable result, excluding process-local receiptHistory view; not Worker transfer or round-trip time
methodology.cpuMs: process.cpuUsage user+system around simulate only, including process background-thread CPU; may exceed wall time. Hashing and cloning are excluded.
methodology.hashing: SHA-256 of JSON; non-finite numbers use {$number:String(value)}. Result hash covers Worker-transferable data; receipts separately hashed in order. Input checked unchanged after every run.

timingPrecision: Rounded to 0.000001 ms; full local reports retain original floating-point samples. Each sample identity was checked against its fixture identity.
